stem: What percentage of Year $12$ students reported having had sexual intercourse, according to the $30$-year trend data?
explanation: The surveys consistently show that about half of the Year $12$ population has had an experience of sexual intercourse.
rationale: The speaker describes this figure as being the 'average' for the upper secondary group.

optionExplanations.A: This figure more closely represents the reported statistics for Year $10$ students rather than Year $12$.
optionExplanations.B: The surveys consistently show that about half of the Year $12$ population has had an experience of sexual intercourse.
optionExplanations.C: This overestimates the normative data provided for secondary school seniors.
optionExplanations.D: This significantly underestimates the percentage of Year $12$ students who have had sexual intercourse.

source.hint: The speaker describes this figure as being the 'average' for the upper secondary group.
